name: Linear
description: Linear is a product development system combining issue tracking, planning, and AI agent collaboration, built for modern workflows involving both human developers and AI agents.
best_for: Positioned for teams and enterprises combining human development practices with AI workflows, from startups to major enterprises, seeking to increase velocity while reducing operational noise.
features: AI-powered agent integration from PRD drafting to deployment
Intake automation converting feedback into prioritized issues
Code review and diff analysis for human and agent changes
Analytics and dashboards for monitoring progress across teams
Coding session review on mobile and desktop
